variants.briefing:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a [AmbushTarget]. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by [Location]. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike. 

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours. 

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus [ScripAmount] Council Scrip to sweeten the pot. 

- Stows
